name: Ladoke Akintola
contribution: A Nigerian politician, aristocrat, orator, and lawyer.

checks.lead: Chief Samuel Ládòkè Akíntọ́lá () otherwise known as S.L.A. (6 July 1910 – 15 January 1966) was a Nigerian politician, aristocrat, orator, and lawyer. He served as Oloye Aare Ona Kakanfo XIII of Yorubaland and served as premier of Western Nigeria from independence in 1960 until his assassination in 1966.
